name: shots/double
description: Double shot v2 (w15-WEAPONLOOK2): hand-drawn native TWIN parallel bars — two staggered cyan-edged white dashes (one upper-left, one lower-right) that read as the two projectiles the weapon fires; the FLUX single diagonal stair is retired. Distinct from the twin beam's comb and two-way's dart (w15-WEAPONLOOK § 6).
